mutants.label: [does-nothing] check never appends a fail result
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_direct_tier_changes_and_a_gated_id_is_removed: the guard's whole purpose is to fail this co-occurrence.

mutants.label: check drops the tier-hash-unchanged skip, always evaluating manifest removal
mutants.why: Killed by test_passes_when_a_gated_id_is_removed_with_no_direct_tier_change: a gated-ID removal alone, with no tier change, must not fail.

mutants.label: check treats any tier change alone as a fail, ignoring manifest removal
mutants.why: Killed by test_passes_when_direct_tier_changes_with_no_gated_id_removed: a tier change with no gated-ID removal must not fail — the positive conjunct.

mutants.label: check flips the manifest set-difference direction
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_direct_tier_changes_and_a_gated_id_is_removed and test_passes_when_direct_tier_changes_with_no_gated_id_removed together: swapping the direction misses a real removal and flags an addition instead.

mutants.label: check reports the wrong guard name
check drops the skill name from the fail message
mutants.find:
f"{skill}: direct tier changed while a gated id was "
                        "removed from checks.manifest — looks like a demotion"
mutants.replace:
"direct tier changed while a gated id was "
                        "removed from checks.manifest — looks like a demotion"

mutants.label: [control] reword the guard module docstring
mutants.why: Module docstring prose; nothing parses or asserts on it, so no test can observe the change on any path.
mutants.find: Unconditional: no activation precondition at all, and it fires independent
mutants.replace: This guard runs unconditionally: no activation precondition at all, and it fires independent

mutants.label: check reads base content at the base tip instead of the merge-base
mutants.why: Killed by test_reads_base_content_at_the_merge_base_not_the_base_tip: a base branch that moved on after the fork must not read as the PR undoing its changes.

mutants.label: merge-base resolution swallows an unresolvable base ref instead of failing
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_loudly_when_the_base_ref_cannot_be_resolved: an unresolvable base must raise, not fall back to HEAD (which reads as 'no tier change' and silently passes).

mutants.label: check hashes the direct tier at the base tip instead of the merge-base
mutants.why: Killed by test_ok_when_the_pr_retires_an_id_and_only_the_base_branch_moved_the_tier: a tier edit made only on the base branch must not read as the PR's tier change.

mutants.label: check reads the base manifest at the base tip instead of the merge-base
mutants.why: Killed by test_ok_when_the_pr_edits_the_tier_and_the_base_branch_independently_added_an_id: an id the base branch added after the fork is not one the PR removed.
